## Core Services & Capabilities

- AWS Cloud Infrastructure & Architecture: Production provisioning and administration across AWS EC2, Elastic Container Service (ECS), Application Load Balancers (ALB), Amazon S3, Amazon RDS MySQL, Route 53, CloudFront CDN, AWS Certificate Manager (ACM), Virtual Private Clouds (VPC), Subnets, and IAM least-privilege security policies.
- Container Orchestration & Docker Deployments: Authoring optimized multi-stage Dockerfiles, managing container images on Docker Hub, provisioning ECS clusters with EC2 self-managed capacity, configuring Task Definitions with Dynamic Port Mapping (`hostPort: 0`), and setting up ECS Services with Auto Scaling across Availability Zones.
- Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Writing modular, reusable Terraform configurations and AWS CloudFormation templates for automated provisioning of VPC networks, security groups, compute clusters, managed databases, and storage with zero configuration drift.
- CI/CD Pipelines & Automation: Building lightning-fast continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions and Jenkins. Incorporating parallel test runs, dependency caching, automated Docker builds, Amazon ECR/Docker Hub pushes, and zero-downtime rolling ECS deployments.
- Linux Server Administration & Scripting: System administration on Amazon Linux and Ubuntu Server environments, Apache HTTP Server, systemd daemon supervision, SSH key hardening, automated cron jobs for database backups, log archiving, and automated Amazon S3 synchronization.
- Database & SSL Security: Securing transport-level database connections between application containers and AWS RDS MySQL using the official AWS RDS CA certificate bundle (`rds-ca-bundle.pem`), SSL/TLS enforcement, and strict VPC security isolation.
- Full-Stack Digital & Client Commerce Solutions: Delivering end-to-end web applications and digital commerce solutions for retail and wholesale clients using React JS, Firebase Hosting, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, FastAPI, and Laravel 12.

## Selected Projects

- Dockerized FastAPI Todo-List Application on AWS ECS:
  - Overview: Containerized and deployed a FastAPI Todo REST API from a local development environment to an AWS ECS Cluster with self-managed EC2 capacity.
  - Architecture: Tested locally with 13 automated pytest tests in Docker Desktop, published to Docker Hub, provisioned an Auto Scaling Group across multiple Availability Zones, registered tasks using an ECS Task Definition, and maintained 2 desired tasks on an ECS Service.
  - Technologies: FastAPI, Python, Docker, Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, AWS ECS, AWS EC2, Auto Scaling Group, Availability Zones.
  - Docker Hub Image: https://hub.docker.com/r/zaindevops009/todo-api
  - GitHub Repository: https://github.com/zaindevops009/todo-api
  - Case Study: https://zaincloud009.github.io/MuhammadZainPortfolio/project-todo-api.html

- Laravel 12 Cloud Architecture: AWS ECS, ALB & CI/CD:
  - Overview: Production-tested migration of a modern Laravel 12 (PHP 8.2) application to AWS Elastic Container Service (ECS) with EC2 Launch Type, Application Load Balancer (ALB), secure AWS RDS MySQL, and sub-4-minute GitHub Actions CI/CD.
  - Architecture: 3-stage multi-stage Dockerfile (Node 22 Vite frontend build, Composer 2 dependency builder, lightweight PHP 8.2-FPM Alpine runtime with Nginx and Supervisord). Resolved container port conflict via Dynamic Port Mapping (`hostPort: 0`) and ephemeral port range (32768–65535). Enforced SSL CA bundle encryption to RDS MySQL.
  - Technologies: Laravel 12, PHP 8.2, AWS ECS, Amazon EC2, Application Load Balancer, AWS RDS MySQL SSL, Docker, Supervisord, GitHub Actions.
  - GitHub Repository: https://github.com/ZainCloud009/IdeaProj.git
  - Case Study: https://zaincloud009.github.io/MuhammadZainPortfolio/project-laravel-aws.html
  - Technical Guide: https://zaincloud009.github.io/MuhammadZainPortfolio/blog-laravel-ecs-deployment.html

- Awais General Store — Grocery & Daily Essentials Web App:
  - Overview: Designed, developed, and deployed an end-to-end digital grocery e-commerce solution for a retail store client.
  - Features: Interactive product catalog covering groceries, dairy, household essentials, and beverages; instant search & category filtering; dynamic shopping cart; automated Cash on Delivery (COD) checkout; 30–45 minute local delivery routing; and Firebase cloud hosting.

  - Technologies: React JS, Firebase Hosting, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, B2B E-Commerce.
  - Live Platform: https://zurifashion.web.app/

### How does Muhammad Zain achieve zero-downtime container deployments on AWS ECS?
Muhammad Zain uses Dynamic Port Mapping by setting `"hostPort": 0` in the ECS Task Definition. When new container tasks spin up, Docker assigns ephemeral ports (between 32768 and 65535). The Application Load Balancer registers the new task port, performs health checks, and shifts traffic seamlessly before the old container is stopped, avoiding port 80 binding conflicts (`CannotStartContainerError`).
